origin.rustic.amphibian.name: Amphibian
origin.rustic.amphibian.description: An aquatic race excelling in oceans and rivers with water regeneration and free movement, but weakened when dehydrated.
origin.rustic.arachnid.name: Arachnid
origin.rustic.arachnid.description: An agile subterranean predator capable of vertical wall climbing and dampening fall damage.
origin.rustic.archivist.name: Archivist
origin.rustic.archivist.description: A scholarly enchanter who channels experience levels into transmuting blank books into enchanted codices.
origin.rustic.automaton.name: Automaton
origin.rustic.automaton.description: A mechanical construct forged from iron. Does not naturally regenerate health, but repairs itself with iron ingots and feeds on copper.
origin.rustic.barbarian.name: Barbarian
origin.rustic.barbarian.description: A ferocious berserker who sacrifices armor defense for brute strength, high-flying aerial shockwave leaps, and adrenal combat rage.
origin.rustic.blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
origin.rustic.blacksmith.description: A master of metallurgy and weapon forging with innate fire resistance and superior tool repairing efficiency.
origin.rustic.dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
origin.rustic.dragonborn.description: Descendants of noble dragons, bearing innate draconic resilience against fire and the gift of short-burst flight.
origin.rustic.dwarf.name: Dwarf
origin.rustic.dwarf.description: Master subterranean diggers. Gain continuous pickaxe haste, night vision, and damage resistance deep underground below Y=60.
origin.rustic.enderian.name: Enderian
origin.rustic.enderian.description: Born of the Void. Capable of innate teleportation and extended reach, but takes constant damage from water and rain.
origin.rustic.explorer.name: Explorer
origin.rustic.explorer.description: A swift overland trailblazer with enhanced step height, reduced sprinting exhaustion, and campfire rejuvenation.
origin.rustic.farmer.name: Farmer
origin.rustic.farmer.description: An agricultural expert permitted to use watering cans. Moves quickly near crops and reaps double harvest yields.
origin.rustic.farrier.name: Farrier
origin.rustic.farrier.description: An equestrian master who empowers ridden mounts with increased speed, higher jumps, and active regenerative care.
origin.rustic.fisher.name: Fisher
origin.rustic.fisher.description: A specialized coastal gatherer with swift swimming speed, underwater night vision, and maritime resilience.
origin.rustic.fisherman.name: Fisherman
origin.rustic.fisherman.description: A seasoned angler blessed with superior luck and doubled treasure yields while fishing.
origin.rustic.frostborn.name: Frostborn
origin.rustic.frostborn.description: Beings of ice and permafrost, thriving in frozen biomes but vulnerable to heat.
origin.rustic.herbalist.name: Herbalist
origin.rustic.herbalist.description: A botanical expert who accelerates natural plant growth and gathers rare double flora.
origin.rustic.human.name: Human
origin.rustic.human.description: A versatile and balanced baseline race, with no innate supernatural weaknesses or magical boons.
origin.rustic.knight.name: Knight
origin.rustic.knight.description: A heavily armored vanguard with 15% physical damage reduction, cleaver proficiency, and a piercing Mighty Dash.
origin.rustic.lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
origin.rustic.lumberjack.description: A seasoned woodsman capable of felling entire trees in a single chop and crafting bonus timber.
origin.rustic.mason.name: Mason
origin.rustic.mason.description: A fortress stonecutter with extended block reach, increased stone mining speed, and enhanced jump stability on stone.
origin.rustic.miner.name: Miner
origin.rustic.miner.description: A subterranean excavator with 50% reduced stamina exhaustion, doubled stone break speed, and doubled ore yields.
origin.rustic.nitwit.name: Nitwit
origin.rustic.nitwit.description: An unskilled laborer without a dedicated economic trade. Restricted from specialized tools.
origin.rustic.phantom.name: Phantom
origin.rustic.phantom.description: An ethereal stalker capable of turning intangible and phasing through solid blocks, but physically fragile with lower max health.
origin.rustic.salahor.name: Salahor
origin.rustic.salahor.description: A colossal titan with massive bonus health, extended melee reach, high attack power, and complete knockback immunity, at the cost of movement speed.
origin.rustic.sylvan.name: Sylvan
origin.rustic.sylvan.description: Nature spirits attuned to lush forests and canopies, moving with increased speed under dense tree foliage.
origin.rustic.tanner.name: Tanner
origin.rustic.tanner.description: A leatherworking artisan skilled with butchery cleavers, harvesting bonus hides and leather from livestock.
origin.rustic.undead.name: Undead
origin.rustic.undead.description: A necrotic being immune to poison and harm magic. Heals by consuming rotten flesh, but combusts in direct sunlight without head protection.
origin.rustic.vampire.name: Vampire
origin.rustic.vampire.description: Creatures of the night that feast on vitality and burn in sunlight.
power.rustic.amphibian_dry_weakness.name: Dehydration
power.rustic.amphibian_dry_weakness.desc: When outside of water and dry land without rain, you become sluggish and slowed.
power.rustic.amphibian_ignore_water.name: Hydrodynamic
power.rustic.amphibian_ignore_water.desc: You move freely through water without fluid drag or velocity penalties.
power.rustic.amphibian_water_regen.name: Aqueous Vigor
power.rustic.amphibian_water_regen.descr: Submerging in water rapidly regenerates your health.
power.rustic.arachnid_climbing.name: Wall Climbing
power.rustic.arachnid_climbing.descripti: You can climb directly up vertical solid surfaces by moving into them.
power.rustic.arachnid_fall_resist.name: Silken Dampening
power.rustic.arachnid_fall_resist.descri: Your lightweight arachnid frame cushions your descents, reducing fall damage by 60%.
power.rustic.archivist_enchantments.name: Inscribe Codex
power.rustic.archivist_enchantments.desc: Using a book while having at least 5 experience levels consumes 5 levels to transmute the book into an enchanted codex.
power.rustic.automaton_armor.name: Iron Plating
power.rustic.automaton_armor.description: Your chassis is constructed of solid iron, providing natural innate armor (+4 Armor).
power.rustic.automaton_copper_feed.name: Copper Nutrition
power.rustic.automaton_copper_feed.descr: You sustain your mechanical core by consuming copper ingots.
power.rustic.automaton_iron_repair.name: Iron Chassis Repair
power.rustic.automaton_iron_repair.descr: Consuming an iron ingot directly restores 3 hearts of health.
power.rustic.automaton_no_regen.name: Non-Biological
power.rustic.automaton_no_regen.descript: You have no biological metabolism and cannot naturally regenerate health from food saturation.
power.rustic.barbarian_aerial_leap.name: Aerial Leap
power.rustic.barbarian_aerial_leap.descr: [Secondary Active] Launch yourself skyward with immunity to fall damage, releasing a concussive shockwave upon landing that damages and launches foes.
power.rustic.barbarian_brute_strength.de: Your raw physical strength grants +25% attack damage, but your recklessness reduces armor effectiveness by 30%.
power.rustic.barbarian_rage.name: Barbarian Rage
power.rustic.barbarian_rage.description: [Primary Active] Unleash a ferocious battle cry, gaining Strength II, Speed I, and Resistance I for 10 seconds, followed by temporary fatigue.
power.rustic.blacksmith_fire_resist.name: Forge Tolerance
power.rustic.blacksmith_fire_resist.desc: Years working the blazing forge grant you a 50% resistance to all fire and lava damage.
power.rustic.double_ores.name: Ore Duplication
power.rustic.double_ores.description: Your deep expertise in mining veins yields double the minerals from ores.
power.rustic.dragonborn_flight.name: Draconic Wings
power.rustic.dragonborn_flight.descripti: You can sprout wings and take flight, provided you are not weighed down by heavy armor.
power.rustic.dragonborn_resistance.name: Draconic Scales
power.rustic.dragonborn_resistance.descr: Tough fiery scales grant you fire resistance when in flames or lava.
power.rustic.dwarf_pickaxe_haste.name: Pickaxe Affinity
power.rustic.dwarf_pickaxe_haste.descrip: Wielding any pickaxe invigorates you, providing continuous Haste I.
power.rustic.dwarf_underground_resistanc: While deep below ground (Y <= 60), you receive Resistance II against all damage.
power.rustic.dwarf_underground_vision.de: Your eyes are naturally adapted to the dark caverns below Y <= 60, granting night vision.
power.rustic.explorer_campfire_rest.name: Campfire Solace
power.rustic.explorer_campfire_rest.desc: Resting near an active campfire steadily regenerates your health.
power.rustic.explorer_climbers_step.name: Climber's Stride
power.rustic.explorer_climbers_step.desc: Your agile footing allows you to smoothly step up full 1-block obstacles without jumping.
power.rustic.explorer_stamina.name: Trail Runner
power.rustic.explorer_stamina.descriptio: Long distance running is second nature, reducing sprinting exhaustion by 30%.
power.rustic.farmer_crop_speed.name: Harvester's Rush
power.rustic.farmer_crop_speed.descripti: Walking amongst ripening crops grants you increased movement speed.
power.rustic.farmer_double_wheat.name: Bountiful Sheaves
power.rustic.farmer_double_wheat.descrip: Harvesting mature wheat yields doubled crops.
power.rustic.farrier_equine_care.name: Equine Care
power.rustic.farrier_equine_care.descrip: [Primary Active] Tenderly care for your mounted steed, granting it Regeneration II and Absorption.
power.rustic.farrier_mounted_speed.name: Mounted Stride
power.rustic.farrier_mounted_speed.descr: Ridden mounts move 25% faster under your expert guidance (Speed I).
power.rustic.farrier_mount_jump.name: Equestrian Jump
power.rustic.farrier_mount_jump.descript: Your mounted riding guidance grants your steed increased jump height (Jump Boost I).
power.rustic.fisherman_fishing.name: Angler's Fortune
power.rustic.fisherman_fishing.descripti: Holding a fishing rod bestows you with Luck II.
power.rustic.fisherman_more_treasure.des: Fishing reels in rare treasures and high-tier salvaged loot far more often.
power.rustic.fisher_night_sight_water.de: Your eyes penetrate dark waters, granting night vision while submerged.
power.rustic.fisher_sea_legs.name: Sea Legs
power.rustic.fisher_sea_legs.description: You take 15% less damage while operating in aquatic environments.
power.rustic.fisher_swim_speed.name: Pelagic Fins
power.rustic.fisher_swim_speed.descripti: You swim 40% faster through open water.
power.rustic.fisher_waters_luck.name: Ocean's Favor
power.rustic.fisher_waters_luck.descript: Being submerged in water blesses you with Luck I.
power.rustic.herbalist_double_crops.name: Floral Bounty
power.rustic.herbalist_double_crops.desc: Harvesting wild plants and crops yields bonus specimens.
power.rustic.herbalist_growth.name: Nature's Touch
power.rustic.herbalist_growth.descriptio: Crops in your presence mature at a noticeably accelerated rate.
power.rustic.knight_constitution.name: Knightly Constitution
power.rustic.knight_constitution.descrip: Disciplined combat training and physical hardening reduce all incoming damage by 15%.
power.rustic.knight_mighty_dash.name: Mighty Dash
power.rustic.knight_mighty_dash.descript: [Primary Active] Thrust forward in an unstoppable charge, bowling through enemy ranks and knocking foes aside.
power.rustic.lumber_bonus_wood.name: Sawyer's Thrift
power.rustic.lumber_bonus_wood.descripti: You craft 6 planks per log instead of the ordinary 4.
power.rustic.mason_block_reach.name: Mason's Reach
power.rustic.mason_block_reach.descripti: Extends your block interaction and placing reach by +1.5 blocks.
power.rustic.mason_break_speed.name: Stone Carving
power.rustic.mason_break_speed.descripti: You break masonry and stone blocks 30% faster.
power.rustic.mason_jump_boost.name: Solid Footing
power.rustic.mason_jump_boost.descriptio: Standing on stone or brick masonry grants you elevated jumping ability.
power.rustic.more_crop_drops.name: Crop Abundance
power.rustic.more_crop_drops.description: You expertly harvest farm crops, doubling their total yield.
power.rustic.more_stone_break_speed.name: Stonebreaker
power.rustic.more_stone_break_speed.desc: You break stone and subterranean minerals at double speed.
power.rustic.night_vision.name: Night Sight
power.rustic.no_mining_exhaustion.name: Enduring Stamina
power.rustic.no_mining_exhaustion.descri: Mining and physical labor cost 50% less hunger exhaustion.
power.rustic.phantom_dodge.name: Ethereal Dodge
power.rustic.phantom_dodge.description: You have a 30% chance to completely slip through incoming melee attacks.
power.rustic.phantom_less_health.name: Incorporeal Frailty
power.rustic.phantom_less_health.descrip: Existing partially between planes leaves you with -3 hearts (-6 Max HP).
power.rustic.phantom_no_fall_damage.name: Weightless Fall
power.rustic.phantom_no_fall_damage.desc: You are completely immune to fall damage.
power.rustic.phantom_phasing.name: Phase Walking
power.rustic.phantom_phasing.description: While phantomized, you can drift straight through solid walls and blocks.
power.rustic.phantom_prevent_targeting_w: Monsters cannot target or detect you while you are phased into phantom form.
power.rustic.phantom_slow_falling.name: Feather Drift
power.rustic.phantom_slow_falling.descri: You glide softly through the air, descending safely.
power.rustic.prevent_cleaver.name: Cleaver Inexperience
power.rustic.prevent_cleaver.description: You lack the training to wield heavy butchery cleavers effectively.
power.rustic.prevent_watering_can.name: Watering Can Inexperience
power.rustic.prevent_watering_can.descri: You lack the specialized agricultural knowledge required to operate watering cans.
power.rustic.salahor_crushing_grip.name: Crushing Grip
power.rustic.salahor_crushing_grip.descr: Colossal strength grants you +3.0 base melee attack damage.
power.rustic.salahor_health.name: Titan's Bulk
power.rustic.salahor_health.description: Your colossal physique grants you +10 hearts (+20 Max HP).
power.rustic.salahor_heavy_steps.name: Heavy Footsteps
power.rustic.salahor_heavy_steps.descrip: Your massive size slows your overall movement speed by 20%.
power.rustic.salahor_reach.name: Long Stride
power.rustic.salahor_reach.description: Your massive limbs grant you +1.0 block extended attack and reach.
power.rustic.salahor_size.name: Colossal Stature
power.rustic.salahor_size.description: You stand at 1.25x the height of an ordinary human.
power.rustic.salahor_unmoving.name: Immovable
power.rustic.salahor_unmoving.descriptio: Your tremendous mass makes you 100% immune to knockback.
power.rustic.sylvan_forest_speed.name: Forest Stride
power.rustic.sylvan_forest_speed.descrip: You move 30% faster when beneath the canopy of forest biomes.
power.rustic.tanner_leather_harvest.name: Hide Processing
power.rustic.tanner_leather_harvest.desc: Striking livestock with a butchery cleaver extracts 1 to 2 bonus leather hides.
power.rustic.undead_enhanced_food.name: Carrion Feaster
power.rustic.undead_enhanced_food.descri: Rotten flesh and necrotic foods nourish you with greatly amplified hunger and saturation.
power.rustic.undead_food_heal.name: Flesh Mend
power.rustic.undead_food_heal.descriptio: Consuming rotten flesh directly heals 2 hearts of health.
power.rustic.undead_harming_immunity.des: Instant Harming magic heals you rather than damaging you.
power.rustic.undead_less_health.name: Decaying Vessel
power.rustic.undead_less_health.descript: Your undead body has -2 hearts (-4 Max HP).
power.rustic.undead_poison_immunity.name: Toxin Immunity
power.rustic.undead_poison_immunity.desc: As an undead being, you are completely immune to poison.
power.rustic.weakness_sun.name: Sunlight Combustion
power.rustic.weakness_sun.description: You burst into flames under direct sunlight unless sheltered or wearing a helmet.
power.rustic.weakness_water.name: Water Vulnerability
power.rustic.weakness_water.description: Water and rain burn your body, causing constant damage upon contact.
